_note: Voice script for GRID CLASH. 'voice' is the Qwen3-TTS VoiceDesign timbre description shared by every line of a character; 'style' is appended per line. Characters with 'clone' are instead voiced by Qwen3-TTS Base voice cloning of the reference clip (itself a VoiceDesign take), so 'voice'/'style' only document how that reference was made. 'asr' (optional) is the reference text for the character-error-rate check when the spoken text contains non-lexical sounds.

marki.voice: A gigantic minotaur warrior, a male beast with a massive chest. Extremely deep, low-pitched bass voice, rough, raspy and gravelly. He never yells in a high voice: even when furious he growls and roars from deep in the chest, low register throughout, heavy and intimidating.
